visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and red highlights sits on a beige sofa in a brightly lit living room. She wears a white top and looks towards an off-camera person while a laptop sits on a wooden coffee table in front of her. The background shows a white brick wall and a floor lamp. (2) The shot moves to a close-up of the woman leaning forward over the table, resting her chin on her hands and smiling at the camera. A yellow cushion and a potted plant are behind her. (3) The screen transitions to a screen recording of a laptop. A user types into a search bar on a website titled 'TaigiTube'. The interface displays search results featuring video clips from various dramas. (4) The camera returns to the woman, now sitting on the floor next to the table, looking directly into the lens and speaking with animated facial expressions and hand gestures. (5) The final shot shows a brief clip from a drama featuring an older man with a surprised expression, before cutting back to the woman.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A casual conversation begins with an off-camera male voice asking a question. A cheerful, light acoustic guitar BGM with a steady piano rhythm starts. The main female speaker responds with high energy, clear articulation, and a friendly, upbeat pitch contour. (2) Vocal inflection remains high and positive as the woman describes her language skills. BGM maintains a consistent, joyful mood. (3) Technical phase: Sounds of rapid keyboard typing and mouse clicks are audible. Several distinct voices from drama clips overlap briefly with the narration; these include a woman's distressed voice and a man's stern tone, each with varying reverb settings. BGM continues at a lower volume to allow clips to stand out. (4) The woman's voice returns to the foreground with an instructional yet enthusiastic tone. A digital UI 'pop' sound effect accompanies a transition. (5) Final phase: An off-camera male voice makes a joking comment. The audio ends abruptly with a sharp, high-volume vocal burst from a drama clip (a man shouting in Taiwanese), serving as a comedic SFX punchline.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demo -> CTA -> Humor
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To introduce and promote 'TaigiTube', an online tool for learning Taiwanese Hokkien by searching for phrases and seeing how they are used in actual drama clips. The video uses a friendly, vlog-style approach to make language learning seem accessible and fun.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the website and verbal recommendation to viewers to try the 'free materials'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines a personable 'talking head' presentation with direct screen-capture evidence to build trust and demonstrate utility.
